sketch:
Observe: demodulator chain — diode envelope detector followed by
RC low-pass. Student sees the AM input, half-wave rectified signal,
then smoothed envelope (recovered m(t)). RC slider tunes the
low-pass; too fast → ripple, too slow → envelope distortion.
Experiment: recover a hidden m(t) by tuning RC given known f_p and
f_m. Evaluate: from a distorted output, diagnose the RC mismatch.
Wrinkle: coherent demodulation preview — multiply by cos(2πf_p t)
+ LPF gives cleaner recovery; hints at the phase requirement in
the FM exercise.
